entries.scope: Update the direct System.Security.Cryptography.Xml pins and the resulting transitive System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs dependency beyond five published security advisories
entries.rationale: DE: Die Paketaktualisierung schließt fünf bestätigte NuGet-Advisories an einer gemeinsamen Abhängigkeitsgrenze und benötigt nachvollziehbare Auflösungs-, Scan- und Regressionsnachweise. EN: The package update closes five confirmed NuGet advisories at a shared dependency boundary and needs traceable resolution, scan, and regression evidence.
entries.navigationImpact: No navigation change; the existing supply-chain evidence and secure-development gate register remain authoritative.
entries.languageStrategy: German first and English second in synchronized CEFR-B2 evidence text.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Both direct System.Security.Cryptography.Xml references resolve to 10.0.14 and transitively resolve System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs 10.0.14 across all affected project assets. Restore and the repeated transitive vulnerability scan report no known vulnerable packages. A Release solution build, the full test suite, and a PowerShell cmdlet import smoke test preserve legitimate behavior.
entries.risk: High if signed-XML or CMS processing reaches the vulnerable package versions directly or through PowerShell and WCF dependency paths.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: A new cryptography-package advisory, dependency-resolution drift, target-framework change, or new direct use of signed-XML or CMS APIs.
